Monthly Decisions

Investment in physician visits, CME events and detailing. Recall decays about 8% a month, so awareness settles at the level your sustained spend supports.
Price discount offered to insurers for formulary inclusion. Coverage moves toward the level this discount justifies — cut the discount and you lose formulary position.
Regulatory monitoring, INVIMA reporting and training. Below 50 you risk audits and fines; above 80 INVIMA recognition becomes possible.
